title: Randy Smith Lone Pine Kennels
summary: In this exciting episode, host Clayton Stark sits down with Randy Smith for an engaging conversation about one of the most thrilling aspects of outdoor life— coon hunting . Join them as they dive into the world of coon hunting , exploring the history, techniques, and the special bond between hunters and their loyal lone pine coonhounds . In this episode, Clayton and Randy share personal stories about their experiences in the woods, discussing the challenges and triumphs of hunting with these incredible dogs.
